say: A thousand agents start, each on its own files. Each also writes one line in a shared index, so they collide thousands of times, and every collision is redone on the newest code. A hundred and seventy-one files were rejected by the checks and left unchanged; the rest land on main.
The run's own page: the index check, five thousand eight hundred ninety lines, none missing; and every one of the two thousand seven hundred sixty-six collisions was redone.
